panels.description: Orbital materials bay. Ren examines a scarred heat exchanger on a workbench amid practical extraction hardware. Leave upper bay space.
Ren cuts away the damaged end of the exchanger. Keep the tool, cut line and metal clear; leave upper space for the sound.
Ren drops the repairable connector onto the bench beside Alex's salvaged sleeve. Keep the connector dominant and leave upper space.
Ren hands the connector to Alex. Her bright blue glove patch is visible; leave upper space for her final line.

items.speaker: REN
items.text: Build around the break. Customers should be able to fix it.
